blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Trisha Tubu and the Farm Fresh Foxies received a rude welcome from 11-time champion Creamline in their PVL finals debut, losing Game 1 of the 2026 All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series title series, 25-11, 25-16, 25-16, on Saturday at Philsports Arena. “You could really see how experienced Creamline is. Given that this was our first game and our first Finals appearance, there are still a lot of things we need to polish,” said Tubu in Filipino after she was limited to just six points.
